data.long_meaning: The name Kayne originated from the Greek name Caianes, which means 'warrior' or 'fighter'. In Latin, it was translated to Canus, which has the same meaning. This name was popular among early Christians, as they saw their faith as a spiritual battle. The name Kayne carries the meaning “Warrior or Fighter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kayne usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior or fighter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kayne total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_greek.name: Κάιν
in_greek.long_meaning: Κάιν είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει απόκτημα ή κτήτωρ. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με την έννοια της απόκτησης ή της δημιουργίας. Στο Ευαγγέλιο, ο Κάιν αναφέρεται ως ο πρώτος γιος του Αδάμ και της Εύας, και έχει μεγάλη σημασία στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Cainan
